latest_release.name: v2.12.0
latest_release.body:
## What's Changed
* ci: harden GitHub Actions workflows by @flavorjones in https://github.com/basecamp/kamal/pull/1805
* Add native OpenTelemetry support for deploy logs by @lewispb in https://github.com/basecamp/kamal/pull/1803
* Fixes for integration tests on Linux 7/Docker 29 by @djmb in https://github.com/basecamp/kamal/pull/1871
* Worktree safe integration tests by @djmb in https://github.com/basecamp/kamal/pull/1872
* Add value equality to Proxy::Run by @teal-bauer in https://github.com/basecamp/kamal/pull/1818
* fix: passbolt list resources with passwords by @cbldev in https://github.com/basecamp/kamal/pull/1836
* Fix --container-id to produce log output by @airblade in https://github.com/basecamp/kamal/pull/1851
* Fix adapters test helper issue by @skinnyfists in https://github.com/basecamp/kamal/pull/1858
* Revert PR #1503 and improve handling of restart option by @etodanik in https://github.com/basecamp/kamal/pull/1864
* Bump the bundler group across 1 directory with 2 updates by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/basecamp/kamal/pull/1806
* Add a stop_timeout option by @djmb in https://github.com/basecamp/kamal/pull/1813
* Clarify custom error page filenames by @matixlol in https://github.com/basecamp/kamal/pull/1837
* Clarify destination secrets docs by @cookesan in https://github.com/basecamp/kamal/pull/1839
* fix: use portable shebang in sample hooks by @maxonvim in https://github.com/basecamp/kamal/pull/1815
* Add forward_agent option to SSH configuration by @joecottam in https://github.com/basecamp/kamal/pull/1853
* Add a --raw option to exec for unmodified stdout by @djmb in https://github.com/basecamp/kamal/pull/1876
* Ensure local registry is started for remote builders by @fcatuhe in https://github.com/basecamp/kamal/pull/1849
* Bump the github-actions group across 1 directory with 8 updates by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/basecamp/kamal/pull/1845
* Run `git gc --auto` in clone-reset path to bound pack accumulation by @semikolon in https://github.com/basecamp/kamal/pull/1866
* Make AWS Secrets Manager test stubs realistic by @djmb in https://github.com/basecamp/kamal/pull/1875
* Bump the bundler group across 1 directory with 7 updates by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/basecamp/kamal/pull/1874
* Handle UTF-8 git user names in deploy locks by @creadone in https://github.com/basecamp/kamal/pull/1860
* Stringify AWS Secrets Manager values by @seeday in https://github.com/basecamp/kamal/pull/1833
* Add default value for `secrets_path` parameter by @leonvogt in https://github.com/basecamp/kamal/pull/1795
* Add `--lock-wait` to retry deploy lock acquisition by @matthewbjones in https://github.com/basecamp/kamal/pull/1844

## New Contributors
* @teal-bauer made their first contribution in https://github.com/basecamp/kamal/pull/1818
* @cbldev made their first contribution in https://github.com/basecamp/kamal/pull/1836
* @skinnyfists made their first contribution in https://github.com/basecamp/kamal/pull/1858
* @etodanik made their first contribution in https://github.com/basecamp/kamal/pull/1864
* @matixlol made their first contribution in https://github.com/basecamp/kamal/pull/1837
* @cookesan made their first contribution in https://github.com/basecamp/kamal/pull/1839
* @maxonvim made their first contribution in https://github.com/basecamp/kamal/pull/1815
* @joecottam made their first contribution in https://github.com/basecamp/kamal/pull/1853
* @fcatuhe made their first contribution in https://github.com/basecamp/kamal/pull/1849
* @semikolon made their first contribution in https://github.com/basecamp/kamal/pull/1866
* @creadone made their first contribution in https://github.com/basecamp/kamal/pull/1860
* @seeday made their first contribution in https://github.com/basecamp/kamal/pull/1833
